after.tests/test_notices.py:
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import build_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student

PUPIL = Student("7", "Rivera", "Ana", "A")


def mark(day, status="absent", who="7"):
    return Mark(who, day, status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_days_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            mark(date(2026, 9, 9)),
            mark(date(2026, 9, 2)),
            mark(date(2026, 9, 3), "present"),
            mark(date(2026, 9, 4), "excused"),
        ]
        text = build_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        want = "Ana Rivera missed 2 days: "
        want += "2026-09-02, 2026-09-09."
        self.assertEqual(text, want)

    def test_single_day(self):
        text = build_notice(PUPIL, [mark(date(2026, 9, 2))])
        self.assertIn("missed 1 day:", text)

    def test_other_student_rejected(self):
        marks = [
            mark(date(2026, 9, 2)),
            mark(date(2026, 9, 3), who="8"),
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        marks = [mark(date(2026, 9, 2), "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, [])
